name: cyclic-type-definitions-test-3fce5ad632/cyclic-type-definitions-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.error lists only `message`.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" includes `error:message` but not `error:detail`.
Supported language features (subset 10) > Expressions lists New expression, List constructor and Mapping constructor, but does not list table constructor or object constructor expressions.
reason: The whole case requires unsupported behavior: both cyclic error tests invoke error2.detail() and assert the returned detail record's exact string representation. The error langlib and method-call allowlists support message only, so these assertions require an unsupported langlib operation. This alone establishes feature regardless of support for recursive types elsewhere in the case.
unsupported_constructs: error:detail invoked as error2.detail() in testCyclicErrorTypeDefinition and testCyclicReadonlyErrorTypeDefinition
Table constructor expressions in the cyclic table tests and an object constructor expression in testCyclicObjectTypeDefinition are absent from the supported expression list
test_design_notes: main invokes all test functions; the detail assertions are part of the required execution path.
No @args, @panic or @output directives appear. Assertions require successful execution and panic only on mismatch.
The empty io:print call is instrumentation and does not determine classification.
